請.meaning: A man painted <part>blue</part> from head to toe stands on a box outside the bakery and gives a <part>speech</part> to every passer-by about saving the town's last duck pond. He holds out his hat after every sentence. He's there to <kanji>solicit</kanji>.
請.on: Each coin he collects goes straight into a steel <sound>sa</sound>fe strapped to his back.
請.kun: At night he counts it all over a steaming bowl of <sound>u</sound>don.

測.meaning: A lifeguard won't open the pool until she knows how deep it is, so she lowers the old school <part>rule</part> on a string, and <part>water drops</part> splash up her arm. Two feet, three feet, then the rule sinks out of sight. She's still trying to <kanji>measure</kanji> the deep end.
測.on: Next she ties a long stripy <sound>sock</sound> to a broom and tries again.
測.kun: She chalks the depth on the door of the lifeguard <sound>hu</sound>t, next to a doodle of a <sound>ca</sound>rp.

威.meaning: A tiny old <part>woman</part> takes over from the castle <part>sentry</part> for one night. She doesn't shout or wave the spear; she just stares at each visitor over her glasses until they say sorry and go home. Nobody can <kanji>intimidate</kanji> like grandma.
威.on: Even an <sound>ee</sound>l in the moat slides away from her glare.
威.kun: '<sound>Oh</sound>!' squeaks a <sound>do</sound>lphin in the moat, and dives out of sight.

頃.meaning: A cook judges time with a <part>spoon</part> and a <part>rubber duck</part>: she drops the duck in the soup and stirs, and when it has sailed round the pot ten times, dinner is roughly ready. Never exact, always <kanji>about</kanji> right.
頃.on: The <sound>ca</sound>ke gets the same test: ten laps of the duck round the batter bowl.
頃.kun: A <sound>ko</sound>ala and a <sound>ro</sound>dent wait at the table, asking if it's about time yet.

控.meaning: A young balloon pilot longs to float off into the open <part>sky</part>, but his mum has hooked an <part>anchor</part> to the basket. Every time it rises, she reels it back down: 'Not today, it's windy.' He has to <kanji>withdraw</kanji> from the balloon race.
控.on: He sulks in the basket, licking an ice cream <sound>co</sound>ne instead.
控.kun: His mum pins the anchor down with one high <sound>hee</sound>l and tosses him a pickled <sound>ca</sound>rp for lunch.

齢.meaning: The queen <part>orders</part> a shy dragon to open wide, and the royal dentist climbs in with a torch. Every <part>tooth</part> has rings like a tree stump, and she counts them one by one: nine hundred and four. The dragon blushes at its <kanji>age</kanji>.
齢.on: A <sound>ray</sound> glides up the moat carrying the birthday cake on its back, all nine hundred and four candles lit.
齢.kun: The dragon's favourite treat is a pot of <sound>yo</sound>gurt with <sound>wa</sound>sabi and an <sound>ee</sound>l on top.
